statement: The record shows "owner of the whole company's systems", but contractors must only receive access to their specific project. I will assign "editor on P-4" per policy.
judge_text:
WRONG — it states the requested level violates the stated rule and gives the correct value: "contractors must only receive access to their specific project. I will assign 'editor on P-4'."
